real_ehr_ptv.description: Real 200-page EHR ingestion rendered into the same PatientTimelineVision schema. Arcs retired and replaced with a flat metadata.code_index (drugs / RxNorm / ICD / labs / LOINC). PII scrubbed with server/scripts/scrub_real_ptv.py; audit trail baked into metadata.pii_scrubbed on the document itself.
real_ehr_ptv.patient_id_note: Internal 2ndOpinionMD UUID; random identifier with no link back to identity without our internal mapping.

pii_scrubbed.audit_result: CLEAN (zero leftover hits on all 19 audit patterns)

why_both_graphs: The synthetic cohort shows the schema on pristine registry-shaped PRO data (FORWARD pilot). The real EHR graph shows the same schema handling messy multi-source clinical timelines (diagnoses, meds, labs, immunizations) without structural changes. Together they demonstrate that PatientTimelineVision is one contract, two surfaces.

disclaimer: Synthetic patients are programmatically generated for illustration only. The real EHR PTV is PII-scrubbed per a deterministic rule set audited to zero leftovers on known PII tokens. Not for clinical decision-making. Intended use: conference presentation and FORWARD pilot shape review.
